The provided documents detail two distinct but related aspects of the Strata software ecosystem: a highly technical optimization campaign for Intel Arc GPUs and comprehensive user-facing documentation for the Strata inference platform.

**A770 Speed Optimization Campaign**
The first document, `A770_SPEED_SPEC.md`, outlines a rigorous engineering effort to achieve at least 20 tokens per second (tok/s) in decode throughput on an Intel Arc A770 GPU running the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Coder model. The baseline performance was established at approximately 12.0–12.6 tok/s. The campaign systematically tested various optimization levers, including kernel tuning, register allocation, and configuration switches.

Initial work packages focused on reliable event-based measurements and BF16 projection paths. Microbenchmarks revealed that the default `bf16_gemv_fp32_mmvf_multi` path was superior to row-based alternatives, which were 1.4–6x slower. Register tuning (GRF 128/256) and subgroup adjustments proved neutral or detrimental. Consequently, the team concluded that BF16 projection geometry and register allocation were not bottlenecks.
